# truenas_ssh_config (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS SSH service configuration. Takes no arguments: there is exactly one SSH configuration per TrueNAS system. SSH host keys are server-managed and are not exposed by this datasource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `bindiface` (List of String) Interfaces to bind the SSH service to. Empty list binds to all interfaces.
- `compression` (Boolean) Whether SSH compression is enabled.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "ssh_config".
- `kerberosauth` (Boolean) Whether Kerberos authentication is enabled.
- `options` (String) Extra sshd_config options, appended verbatim.
- `password_login_groups` (List of String) Groups whose members are allowed to authenticate with a password.
- `passwordauth` (Boolean) Whether password authentication is enabled.
- `sftp_log_facility` (String) SFTP subsystem syslog facility. One of "" (default), DAEMON, USER, AUTH, LOCAL0-LOCAL7.
- `sftp_log_level` (String) SFTP subsystem syslog level. One of "" (default), QUIET, FATAL, ERROR, INFO, VERBOSE, DEBUG, DEBUG1, DEBUG2, DEBUG3.
- `tcpfwd` (Boolean) Whether TCP forwarding is enabled.
- `tcpport` (Number) TCP port the SSH service listens on.
- `weak_ciphers` (List of String) Weak ciphers to allow. Valid values: AES128-CBC, NONE.
